intro: Pepper table turns small moments generous. Split for snacks and laptops or bring together for a layered centerpiece; the duo flexes with guests, chores, and cozy movie nights with ease.

features.title: Walnut veneer top that feels effortless
features.text: The MDF top in walnut veneer brings a warm, refined look that pairs with any sofa style, giving you a smooth surface for snacks, laptops, and décor without feeling too formal for everyday use.

features.title: Rubber wood legs that stay steady
features.text: Rubber wood legs provide dependable stability day after day, so you can lean in, set things down, and gather around a table that feels balanced through busy mornings and relaxed evenings alike.

features.title: Two-table set that flexes with life
features.text: Two coffee tables arrive as a coordinated set, giving you flexible layouts. Split for side seating and snacks or combine for a layered centerpiece that grows with guests and plans.

features.title: Knockdown build for easy moves
features.text: Knockdown construction passes tight doors and elevators with less fuss. Assemble quickly where it belongs, then rearrange easily when you refresh your living space or move homes again.

features.title: Strength for everyday routines
features.text: Built for daily routines with a 30 kg load capacity, so trays, books, and décor rest securely while you host, study, or unwind without worrying about wobbles, weight, or surface stability.

features.title: One carton for simple arrivals
features.text: Both tables are coded as one set and ship in a single carton, making delivery simpler and setup faster, so you can focus on styling the space and enjoying the room together right away.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
